channel.title: AI Threat Watch: SG
channel.description: Verified case files located in SG.

item.title: [HIGH] Singapore police probe deepfake nudes of Singapore Sports School girls made by male peers
item.description: Male student-athletes at Singapore Sports School allegedly created AI deepfake nude images of female schoolmates from June 2024 and circulated them through WhatsApp groups. The school filed a police report and caned or suspended some students, and police seized phones for forensic checks and sought removal of the images from websites. Target: Female students and some female teachers at Singapore Sports School. SG. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] AI-generated presenters in 550+ TikTok videos spread false claims about Singapore and Malaysia
item.description: A CNA investigation found 30 TikTok accounts running more than 550 videos with AI-created or manipulated female presenters; over 98% were AI-generated or altered, nearly 90% carried false or misleading claims about Singapore and Malaysia, and they drew more than 3 million views. TikTok removed two accounts CNA flagged. Target: Singapore and Malaysia audiences on TikTok. SG. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Singapore businessman loses S$4.9M after Zoom meeting with deepfake PM Lawrence Wong
item.description: Singapore Police said a victim sent at least S$4.9 million (about $3.83M) after a fake Cabinet Secretary invited him to a Zoom briefing with deepfakes of PM Lawrence Wong, the President and MAS officials. Target: Singapore business professional. SG. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Deepfake Zoom call of executives tricks Singapore finance director into $499K transfer
item.description: A finance director joined a Zoom call with deepfaked company executives and wired about US$499,000 to a mule account; Singapore and Hong Kong police traced and froze the funds. Target: Multinational firm (Singapore office). SG. Verification: confirmed.
